source_refs.note: 'Learning From Data' under topic 6.3, as printed (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Learning from data means using past information to improve decisions. In this process, data is given as input to a learning model, which studies relationships in it. Errors are reduced through repeated training, and data becomes more accurate. Learning from data is continuous because the models update when new data is available. This process helps systems become smarter.
